page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with the page number at the top left and the running head at the top centre. No marginal notes, no footnotes.

main_text.p: „ psæ defensionis rationes continent causas: sed distinguendi gratia, rationem appellamus eam, quæ adfertur à reo ad recusandum depellêdi criminis causa: quæ nisi esset, quid defenderet non haberet. Firmamentum autem, quod contrà ad labefaćtandam rationem refertur, sine quo accusatio stare non potest. Ex rationis autem & firmamêti conflictione & qua si concursu, quęstio exoritur quædam, quam disceptationem uoco: in qua quid deueniat in iudicium, & de quo disceptetur, quæri solet. Nam prima aduersariorum contẽtio

page.notes: The opening quotation marks („) are printed at the start of every line down the left side of the column; they are the printer's marks for a quoted passage and are recorded here once rather than repeated. The running head is blotted by a dark stain and cannot be read. The last word of the page, "contẽtio", is printed "conté" at the line end with "tio" below it, written here as one word without a hyphen, as the printer gave no hyphen. The tilde over the e in "contẽtio" is as printed.
